motivation.purpose: Broad real-world business product feedback, user pain points, and customer satisfaction evidence.
motivation.domain: B2B & consumer office products and workspace equipment reviews
research_questions: Can real product reviews ground synthetic persona pain points and purchasing criteria?

composition.instance_type: Product review with rating, title, text, timestamp, and product metadata
composition.slice_description: Office_Products category slice (first 50,000 reviews streamed; avoids bulk 571M download)
composition.sensitive_content: Public user reviews; reviewer IDs anonymized.

collection.collection_mechanism: Scraped public Amazon review pages for academic research.

preprocessing.cleaning_applied: Join review text with metadata; anonymize user identifiers; filter short noise.

intended_uses: Evidence grounding and pain point extraction (Phase 8 persona engine).
prohibited_uses: Commercial redistribution without upstream license compliance

distribution.license_verified_upstream: Academic Research Non-Commercial (UCSD McAuley Lab terms)
distribution.license_notes: Research use only. Bulk redistribution restricted. Streamed category slice used.
